owner_priority_lock.rule: Follow the explicit owner direction to pause technical_refactor and prioritize tour-search UX and user-facing visual work on AnyTour Design System 2.0. New design/layout concepts require owner approval before implementation; already approved DS2 visual layers may be repaired/converged autonomously.

current_stage.name: Search 2.0 initial form convergence to approved mockup
current_stage.last_material_progress: Draft PR #810 now has a dedicated Search 2.0 preview route and a consolidated initial-form visual owner. The initial form is reduced to the approved five primary controls (Откуда, Куда, Когда, Ночи, Туристы) plus the blue Search 2.0 CTA. Mobile order is fields -> CTA -> quick filters -> Все фильтры, document overflow is absent at 375/430/768/1024/1440, and desktop nights stays on one line. Quick filters remain truthful: All Inclusive binds to the real canonical food value 7, Первая линия binds to the real hotel service value 15, and С детьми binds to the real Семейный hotel service value 44 after rejecting the earlier ambiguous child-water-slide match. Service shortcuts are ordered to match the approved mockup direction and CI now clicks them and verifies the underlying canonical hotel_service[] controls are actually selected. All Inclusive is additionally hardened so its preview shortcut is removed outside initial state. Deploy Search 2.0 preview #59 passed all gates at head 7819086e8c8bd1ef7a59c31e126cdb62a11ae6e9; the current branch head additionally records this verified state only. Production remains locked pending owner visual approval.
current_stage.next_action: Continue final initial-form visual polish against the approved Search 2.0 mockup on the preview branch only. Keep truthful catalog-backed quick filters and existing canonical filter access; do not invent unsupported semantics for Рекомендуем, Лучшая цена or Раннее бронирование. Review quick-filter density and spacing at 375/430/768/1024/1440, then update PR #810 evidence for owner preview review. Do not merge or deploy production without explicit owner approval.

local_results_filtering.rule: Result filters such as stars/rating/price/meal and other fields already present in normalized loaded results filter the loaded set instantly. A new Tourvisor search is reserved for real search-input changes or optional background capability expansion, not for every result-filter click.

site_wide_score.note: Held at 7.3. Search 2.0 preview form convergence is materially improved, but it is still preview-only and does not justify a whole-product production score increase before owner approval and release.
